sources.label: Morphe patches to remove ads, analytics, apk junk, debug info, duplicate graphic
sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Fixes Remove Ads And Remove Ads Lite Gettings Stuck In Splash Screen Useless if you also select skip splash and language activity patch. Also stops the splash from hiding the on-screen navigation buttons.
Disable ad dialog when reopening app
Prevents the full-screen "loading ad" dialog from appearing when the app is reopened after being minimized.
Strips WebDownloadActivity's intent-filter data so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.
Stops the notification shortcut service from running as a foreground service so the app no longer stays alive in the background after being removed from recents.
Prevents the rate and star rating dialogs from showing.
Removes the Scan (AD) row from the browser overflow menu.
Removes the unscoped http/https <data> entries from MainActivity's first intent-filter carrying them so the app stops appearing as a candidate in the system's default browser / "open with" chooser.
Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation, the language-selection screen, DONT UNSELECT THIS,IT HAS SIGNATURE BYPASS INCLUDED.
Closes the onboarding tips screen as soon as it opens.
